responsibility: Collects the reusable mode iterators, code iterators, and attributes that parameterize the RISC-V machine descriptions. It defines common abstractions for XLEN-dependent scalar modes, floating-point and atomic modes, bitmanip and arithmetic code families, and naming/printing attributes such as load/store mnemonics and optab suffixes, allowing riscv.md and companion .md files to share compact pattern templates instead of duplicating per-mode definitions.
